Amumu.escape: Engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy have been used. Amumu has no skill to create distance on his own, so after closing in, you can stop his escape with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike. If you are immobilized, cleanse it with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar and get out.
Amumu.fight: Use a brush leap to engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu cannot create distance on his own, so root him with Rengar E Bola Strike, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking his retaliation damage. If you are still immobilized, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Amumu.teamfight: After Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used on your team’s frontline, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and flank from the side or rear. Approach so your target is the nearest enemy when you leap, and do not leap first onto Amumu or the frontline. Plan your exit route before engaging, and make use of Rengar W Battle Roar’s healing and your empowered skill’s crowd control cleanse.
Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces the physical damage he takes, so prioritize armor penetration. Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and prioritize tenacity or a crowd control cleanse against Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Avoid relying on health alone because of Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow Amumu. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your landing attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Amumu’s retaliation. If Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is still available, save Ferocity so you can use empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Amumu.laning: Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to manage his jungle health and prioritizes gank routes with brushes. Lower the priority of ganks where you cannot use a brush.
Amumu.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the backline. In the late game, vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so play to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target it hits, so dodge it by keeping minions or jungle monsters between you and Amumu. While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, stay spread out with your allies and avoid fighting in tight spaces. If you are caught, you will take Amumu W Despair’s percent max health damage for a long time, so use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage.

Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has high kill participation, so be wary of Rengar ganking outside brushes or engaging without vision. Rengar is strong in the mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so create chances to pick off the backline from the side. In the late game, vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so play to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage. If healing from Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, or Briar E Chilling Scream turns the duel around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Briar.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow Briar as you land. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your attack to fill the time between attacks, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Briar’s retaliation. If Briar can escape, use Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to root her; if you are already on her and she has no immobilizing counterattack, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar Q Savagery.
Briar.escape: Do not engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Your window is after Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is also down and before Briar R Certain Death comes back; use empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to stop her escape.
Briar.fight: Close in with a brush leap, but if Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack are both available, prepare empowered Rengar E Bola Strike with a way to keep chasing in mind. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking a heavy hit from Briar’s retaliation to restore health. If a counterattack with immobilizing crowd control is possible, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Briar.laning: In the jungle, Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to manage his health and keep clearing camps, and prioritizes gank angles that allow a leap from a brush. If you meet Briar in the jungle, you can lower her health and delay her next route even if you cannot kill her. Avoid reckless engages in areas without vision, and use Briar’s gank attempts as chances to counterattack when you have vision.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she chases the nearest enemy, so position your team’s frontline in her path of approach. Rengar should not start from the front; use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then flank from the side or rear. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing skill is used on your frontline, then use Rengar W Battle Roar and empowered effects to get out after your burst.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces your armor, so choose an angle that avoids it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, avoid standing with your back to a wall; if you are stunned, cleanse it with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and marks you as prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of running alone.

Brand.combo: Leap from a brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and cast Rengar E Bola Strike to slow Brand as you land. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your landing attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after Brand retaliates and damages you. If Ferocity is full, use empowered W when you need to cleanse Brand Q Sear’s stun, or empowered Q when you can stay on him safely.
Brand.build: Brand deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your max health, so do not rely on increasing health alone. Build movement speed so you can get out of area attacks such as Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility skill, so close the gap after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you are ablaze, plan a route to dodge Brand Q Sear’s stun or prepare empowered Rengar W Battle Roar before going in.
Brand.fight: Look to engage right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Close the gap with Rengar P Unseen Predator’s brush leap and catch him with Rengar E Bola Strike. If you are in a state where Brand Q Sear can stun you, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Brand.laning: In the jungle, Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to heal damage taken and keep moving between camps. On Brand’s lane, first look for an angle that lets you leap from a brush. If Brand has set minions ablaze, stay away from burning minions and engage after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down.
Brand.phase: Early on, Rengar’s gank opportunities depend on the brush terrain, so prioritize lanes with a leap angle. In the mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, target Brand from behind to build a lead. In the late game, vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so play to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. After an immobilizing attack such as Brand Q Sear is used on your team’s frontline, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate Brand and engage from the side or rear. After attacking Brand, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar and escape along your preplanned route.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you are hit by his skills in quick succession, so focus on dodging his opening attack, Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear. While ablaze, Brand Q Sear stuns you, so dodge the projectile or move behind minions. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from your allies to reduce the damage from its bounces.

Hecarim.laning: Leaping from brush lets you close the gap while gaining Ferocity, but from an angle without brush you must cast Rengar E Bola Strike first, giving the opponent time to respond.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther Hecarim has run, so when Hecarim starts running while creating distance, break vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows fears, so spread out to avoid multiple allies being hit together.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. If the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread interferes with a kill, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Hecarim.combo: Engage with a leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow Hecarim. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack to fill the time between attacks, then recover with Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after taking retaliation. If Hecarim still has an escape available, build Ferocity for the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike; when you are sure you can stay on him, use empowered Rengar Q Savagery to concentrate your damage.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage just because only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Look for an opening after Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is down, and use Rengar E Bola Strike to stop his movement and engage when Hecarim E Devastating Charge is also unavailable. If there is still a chance you will be hit by the fear from Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, be ready to spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, use Rengar E Bola Strike to hinder Hecarim's movement, reducing both his approach and damage. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to restore health.
Hecarim.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item, so build an advantage with picks on the back line. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to finish the game.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear multiple allies. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets and circle around from the flank or rear; engage after the opponent's immobilizing abilities have been used on your frontline. Plan an escape route before going in, and after taking retaliation, recover with Rengar W Battle Roar or cleanse crowd control with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.

Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first. Increase your total health to prepare for the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If Bel'Veth’s healing keeps you from securing a kill, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Belveth.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike before landing to slow Bel'Veth. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your attack to fill the gap between attacks, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Bel'Veth’s retaliation. Use empowered E if Bel'Veth can escape with Q Void Surge, or empowered W if you need to withstand Bel'Veth W Above and Below’s knockup.
Belveth.escape: Sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below; the moment Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down is your chance to engage. Q has separate cooldowns for each direction, so approach based on the axis she just dashed along, and root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike before she can escape with her next Q.
Belveth.fight: Fight Bel'Veth early, before she stacks, and slow her growth. After sidestepping Bel'Veth W Above and Below, unload damage once Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. If Bel'Veth can escape with Q Void Surge, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Belveth.laning: During jungle clears, Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to heal the damage taken and keep moving between camps. For ganks, prioritize angles that let you leap from a brush.
Belveth.phase: Early on, when Bel'Veth has few stacks, pressure her and steal camps and large monsters. Rengar is strong in the mid game once his ultimate and first core item are ready, so consolidate your lead then. Bel'Veth’s permanent stacks keep growing over time, and Rengar’s engages become harder, so play to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Belveth.teamfight: Save your burst while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, and engage from the side after Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and approach so the target is the nearest enemy. If an ally falls and leaves behind a Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay teamfights while Bel'Veth’s transformation is active.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you airborne and also resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, so wait until it ends before unloading Rengar’s burst. When low on health, watch out for Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s missing health-based true damage.

Diana.build: Get movement speed first so you can escape Diana’s telegraphed area attacks. For defenses, build magic resistance against the magic damage from Diana P Moonsilver Blade, Q Crescent Strike, and W Pale Cascade.
Diana.combo: When Diana W Pale Cascade is down and you have an angle to engage, leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair. After landing, attack and use Rengar Q Savagery to fill the gap between attacks. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Diana’s retaliation, and spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike if you need to prevent her escape.
Diana.escape: Your window to engage is right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike. Slow her with Rengar E Bola Strike or empower it to root her. If you are hit by Q Crescent Strike, back away because it can reset Diana E Lunar Rush.
Diana.fight: Start the fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without first using Q Crescent Strike, catch her with Rengar E Bola Strike and attack. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking a heavy hit to restore health.
Diana.laning: Lower the gank priority of lanes where you cannot use a brush.
Diana.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game once R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the backline and build a lead then. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so you need to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from each other so multiple allies are not pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and look for a flank angle. Rengar should not start from the front; use R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Target the backline after the enemy’s immobilizing skill is used on your frontline, and if you take retaliation, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar and get out.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike applies a mark that can reset Diana E Lunar Rush’s cooldown, so sidestep as it flies toward you. Do not engage right after Diana W Pale Cascade activates; wait until its orbs and shield disappear. In teamfights, spread out so multiple allies are not pulled in by Diana R Moonfall.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s damage. If you have no mobility option to avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun, consider tenacity first. If healing from Ekko R Chronobreak turns a kill around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair. After landing, attack and use Rengar Q Savagery to fill the time between attacks, then use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking retaliation. If Ekko can escape, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike; if you are sure you can stay on him, use empowered Rengar Q Savagery to unload damage.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, do not chase all the way because Ekko R Chronobreak can let him escape. Start the full fight during the window when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If he has just used Ekko E Phase Dive, stop his escape with Rengar E Bola Strike.
Ekko.fight: Dodge the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence and wait for Ekko R Chronobreak to be down. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive closes the gap, he has no mobility skill available, giving you a chance to root him with Rengar E Bola Strike. If you take a heavy hit from his retaliation, use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately afterward to heal.
Ekko.laning: During jungle clears, Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to manage his health and keep moving between camps. For ganks, prioritize routes that let you leap from a brush. If you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its area and find a new angle to engage.
Ekko.phase: Rengar is strong in the mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so look for a chance when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In the late game, vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so finish the game with the lead you built in the mid game.
Ekko.teamfight: Do not start from the front; use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun, and root him with Rengar E Bola Strike right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. Plan your exit route before engaging, and cleanse immobilization with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Also step away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see an afterimage behind Ekko, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not chase recklessly even if health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Consider tenacity as well if Elise E Cocoon’s stun is a problem. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen turns a kill around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Elise.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow Elise. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your landing attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after Elise retaliates. If Ferocity is full, use empowered E to stop Elise’s escape, empowered W if Cocoon is still available, or empowered Q when you have her firmly caught.
Elise.escape: Hit Elise with Rengar E Bola Strike right after she closes the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite to get a chance to counterattack. If both Elise E Rappel and Elise E Cocoon are down, it is a good time to counter-engage. Do not rush your skills while she is using E Rappel; target where she will land.
Elise.fight: Confirm that both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down before counter-engaging. Close in with a brush leap, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after Elise retaliates and damages you. If Cocoon is still available, decide before engaging whether to spend Ferocity on empowered W.
Elise.laning: Early on, secure vision so Elise cannot get kills with ganks, and do not push the lane too aggressively when she is out of sight. Rengar uses Rengar W Battle Roar to manage his health and keep clearing the jungle. For ganks, prioritize angles that let you leap from a brush.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch out for Elise trying to build a lead with ganks and do not give up kills. Rengar is strong in the mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the backline and secure your lead then. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so look for a chance to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Elise.teamfight: Do not start from the front; use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Engage after Elise E Cocoon is used on your team’s frontline, and set your path so the target is the nearest enemy when you leap. After the kill, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar or cleanse remaining crowd control with empowered W, then escape along your preplanned route.
Elise.watch: When health is full, watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin; after health has decreased, watch for a finisher in R Spider Form.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage and prepare Control Wards. Evelynn W Allure reduces your magic resistance, so prioritize backing away before the mark matures. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade keeps you from securing a kill, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Evelynn.combo: Leap from a brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike before landing to slow Evelynn. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your landing attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking retaliation. If Evelynn R Last Caress is unavailable, use the empowered slot on Rengar E Bola Strike to root her, then attack.
Evelynn.escape: If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so check what mobility she has left. In particular, engage before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back, after dodging the charm from Evelynn W Allure. At that point, stop her exit with the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance while the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and look to fight before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back. When engaging, root Evelynn with Rengar E Bola Strike, and use an empowered skill on Rengar Q Savagery when you are sure you can stay on her. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from her retaliation.
Evelynn.laning: Also place wards beside jungle camps where Evelynn starts combat to track her position. Rengar prioritizes ganking lanes where he can leap from a brush, and manages his health during jungle clears with Rengar W Battle Roar.
Evelynn.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the backline and secure your lead then. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers, so watch for her engage where your team has vision. If she dives in, look for a chance to catch her with the root from Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and engage from the side or rear; after taking retaliation, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar and get out.
Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, back away and alert your allies before the charm lands. When low on health, Evelynn R Last Caress deals sharply increased damage, so do not stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest healing prevents a kill, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks' damage. Prioritize tenacity too if fear and silence keep you in Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm for a long time.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow as you land. If you can spend Ferocity on damage, use Rengar empowered Q Savagery, then basic attack; immediately after taking the opponent's retaliation, recover with Rengar W Battle Roar and continue basic attacking. Save your empowered ability for the root on Rengar E Bola Strike if you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest or Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Rooting Fiddlesticks with Rengar empowered E Bola Strike here makes it difficult for him to escape. Engage after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and his other ways to retaliate have been used. If immobilizing crowd control remains, save Ferocity for Rengar empowered W Battle Roar.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks starts Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, interrupt the channel with your saved Rengar empowered E Bola Strike. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to restore health. If you can stay on him and he has no way to retaliate, spend Ferocity on Rengar empowered Q Savagery to concentrate your damage.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Keep vision in the brush behind the lane, and do not walk past a stationary Scarecrow Effigy before checking it. Lower your gank priority when you cannot approach from an angle that lets you use brush.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item, so build an advantage by picking off the back line. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so use your mid-game lead to finish the game.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and do not group in narrow passages without vision. Secure vision with Control Wards in the brush in front of objectives and on approach paths, then use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets before approaching from the flank or rear. Attack the back line after Fiddlesticks' crowd control has been used on your frontline, and before engaging, plan a route for escaping with the help of Rengar W Battle Roar.
Fiddlesticks.watch: In brush without vision, watch for Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm ambushes and fear. If you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it with Rengar empowered E Bola Strike; if you cannot, leave its area. Fiddlesticks E Reap silences enemies caught in the center of the formation, so do not stand in the middle.

Gragas.build: Gragas has fairly high armor, so include penetration in your core build to make the most of Rengar's physical damage. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Gragas' damage. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour interferes with a kill, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Gragas.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after the basic attack on landing to fill the time between attacks, then recover with Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after taking Gragas' retaliation. If Ferocity is full, prioritize Rengar E Bola Strike's root against Gragas' escape, and Rengar W Battle Roar's cleanse against immobilizing effects.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam is his mobility, so the moment right after making him use it is your opening to engage. If Gragas' immobilizing effects may still be available, engage while saving Ferocity to empower Rengar W Battle Roar. When chasing Gragas deep, account for how quickly Gragas E Body Slam can come back after it hits.
Gragas.fight: Hold your burst while Gragas drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage, then deal damage after the effect ends. Close the gap right after making Gragas use Gragas E Body Slam, and block his escape with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike. If you take heavy damage in retaliation, use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately afterward to recover.
Gragas.laning: In the jungle, keep clearing camps while restoring health with Rengar W Battle Roar. When ganking a lane with Gragas, approach from an angle that lets you leap from brush, and engage after Gragas uses Gragas E Body Slam.
Gragas.phase: In the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, build an advantage with picks on the back line. Gragas' sustained damage falls off in the late game, but enemy vision and defensive items also make it harder for Rengar to engage, so close out the game with your mid-game lead.
Gragas.teamfight: After Gragas E Body Slam has been used on your frontline, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets and approach from the flank or rear. Choose a route that keeps Gragas from being the closest enemy so you can leap onto a back-line target. Plan your escape before engaging, and disengage after your burst with Rengar W Battle Roar's healing or its empowered crowd-control cleanse.
Gragas.watch: Leave the radius when you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If you are near the barrel and also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam, you can easily take both damage and crowd control. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask available, do not stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.

Graves.build: Graves' main damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early to prepare for early- and mid-game fights.
Graves.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike before landing to slow. Press Rengar Q Savagery right after the leap attack to empower your next basic attack, then recover with Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after taking retaliation and continue basic attacking. If Graves still has an escape available, use your empowered ability on the root from Rengar E Bola Strike.
Graves.escape: Do not engage immediately just because only Graves E Quickdraw is down. Look for an opening before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, and catch him with Rengar E Bola Strike when Graves E Quickdraw is also down. If Graves W Smoke Screen is placed, leave its area first, then re-engage.
Graves.fight: Fight back while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Move through brush to leap, and if Graves uses Graves E Quickdraw to create distance, catch him with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to restore health.
Graves.laning: While clearing the jungle, manage your health with Rengar W Battle Roar and keep up your farming and ganks. Prioritize ganks from angles that let you leap from brush. Pressure Graves early so he has no room to build stacks on Graves E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: Graves gets stronger as he builds stacks on Graves E Quickdraw, so pressure his growth from the early game. Play to finish the game with your mid-game lead.
Graves.teamfight: Do not start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets, then circle around from the flank or rear. Engage on the back line after the opponent's immobilizing abilities have been used on your frontline, and choose a route that makes your target the closest enemy. After your burst, recover with Rengar W Battle Roar. If immobilizing crowd control remains, cleanse it with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. Escape along your preplanned route.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so do not fight with a wall behind you or in a narrow jungle passage. If you are caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, take the shortest path out of its area, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny's basic attack is stopped by the first unit hit, so put minions or allies between you and Graves in a chaotic fight.

Ivern.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair, then use a basic attack on landing followed by Rengar Q Savagery to fill the time between attacks. If the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller remains, save your empowered ability for Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse it; if Ivern tries to escape, root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Ivern.escape: The moment after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down is your opening to engage.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap right after making Ivern use Ivern Q Rootcaller, then block his escape with Rengar E Bola Strike. Do not leap onto a target already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; wait for the shield to burst. Use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after taking heavy damage in retaliation to recover.
Ivern.laning: Prioritize ganks from angles that let you leap from brush, and move carefully beside brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item, so pick off the back line then. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so finish the game with your mid-game lead.
Ivern.teamfight: Do not start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets, then approach from the flank or rear. After picking off the back line, escape with Rengar W Battle Roar's healing or its empowered effect.
Ivern.watch: If you are rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern's allies can also dash to you, so avoid the angle by keeping minions or terrain in between even before firing. Attack a target with Ivern E Triggerseed after its shield bursts, and move away when Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you to break her chain of attacks.
Ivern.build: The source does not specify a particular first item. Magic resistance is more effective than armor for withstanding Ivern's damage, but prioritize tenacity when allies follow up after crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!.

JarvanIV.combo: Leap from brush with a basic attack, cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery immediately after landing and basic attacking.
JarvanIV.laning: Prioritize ganking from angles that let Rengar leap from brush, and manage your health with Rengar W Battle Roar while clearing the jungle.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Do not engage from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate a back-line target, then approach from the flank or rear. After a kill, recover with Rengar W Battle Roar or cleanse crowd control with its empowered effect, then escape along your planned route.

Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for damage, so prioritize items that reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. If Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable, use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack. Use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately after taking heavy damage from his counterattack to recover. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking; when you are at risk of being stunned, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your opening to root him with Rengar E Bola Strike and engage. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, you can continue basic attacking. If Jax closes in while it is active, move outside the stun radius and save your mobility ability to create distance then.
Jax.fight: Start trading after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Leap from brush to close the gap, but stop basic attacking and back off if Jax E Counter Strike activates. When you re-engage, if Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, pin him with Rengar E Bola Strike.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so do not force an all-in. Find an angle that lets you leap from brush, and chase with Rengar E Bola Strike after Jax Q Leap Strike is down.
Jax.phase: Rengar is strong in the mid game with his ultimate and first core item, while enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage in the late game.
Jax.teamfight: Avoid grouping around Jax so multiple allies do not get hit by the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets and circle around from the flank or rear; engage after immobilizing abilities such as Jax E Counter Strike have been used. After a kill, use Rengar W Battle Roar's healing or its empowered crowd-control cleanse to escape along your planned route.
Jax.watch: Do not use basic attacks or the empowered basic attack from Rengar Q Savagery while Jax E Counter Strike is active. Your attacks will be dodged and his counterattack will deal more damage, so move outside the stun radius and wait for the duration to end.

Karthus.build: The information available isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Karthus’s damage. Still, your priority is to dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and get out of Karthus E Defile quickly.
Karthus.combo: Leap from a bush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. After landing, use Rengar Q Savagery right after your basic attack to empower the next one, then use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal after taking Karthus’s retaliation. If max Ferocity is ready and you can stay on him, spend it on empowered Rengar Q Savagery; if you need to hold him in place, spend it on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, so there’s no need to wait for one to go down. Approach along a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain, then close the gap with a bush Leap or Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. After killing him, immediately move away from his body while Karthus P Death Defied is active.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no skills to create distance, so look for chances to close in with a bush Leap. Throw Rengar E Bola Strike during the Leap to slow him; if you have max Ferocity, you can root him. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore health right after taking Karthus’s retaliation.
Karthus.laning: Leaping from a bush lets you engage and gain Ferocity. If the angle doesn’t let you use a bush, lower the gank priority.
Karthus.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so target Karthus in the back line. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to end the game.
Karthus.teamfight: Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate Karthus, then approach from the side or behind. Even after you kill him, Karthus P Death Defied can still deal damage, so immediately change position and move away from his body. Plan an escape route before engaging, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking retaliation.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals increased damage when it hits you alone, so walk out of the blast when you see it coming and, if possible, stand with an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Even after Karthus is killed, Karthus P Death Defied lets him use Q Lay Waste and E Defile, so move away from his body immediately. After a fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against Kayn's main ability damage. If healing from his Rhaast form becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kayn.combo: Leap from brush and cast Rengar E Bola Strike in midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery immediately after landing and basic attacking. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from Kayn's retaliation to recover. Before engaging, plan to use empowered Rengar E Bola Strike if you are worried Kayn will escape, or empowered Rengar W Battle Roar if you need to counter the immobilizing effect from Kayn W Blade's Reach.
Kayn.escape: Do not rush in while Kayn Q Reaping Slash is the only ability down, since Kayn can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. It is better to dodge the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach, then land the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn before he transforms, but do not engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down. Look for an opening before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back and block his escape with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike. If Kayn enters a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, you can immediately interrupt him with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike.
Kayn.laning: In the early game, manage your health with Rengar W Battle Roar as you follow your jungle route, and prioritize ganks on lanes where you can leap from brush. Pressure Kayn's jungle route before he transforms and force objectives, but do not get killed early and speed up his transformation. If a warning marker appears at the edge of a wall Kayn has entered, stop fighting and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item, so build an advantage with picks on the back line. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so finish the game with your mid-game lead.
Kayn.teamfight: Do not start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate targets, then circle around from the flank or rear. Enter the back line after the opponent's immobilizing abilities have been used on your frontline, and plan your escape route in advance with Rengar W Battle Roar and your empowered ability in mind. If Kayn uses Kayn R Umbral Trespass on an ally, interrupt him with the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike as he emerges near his target.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach to reduce Kayn's chance to enter from long range with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your max health, so recover with Rengar W Battle Roar after it hits.

Khazix.build: Build armor first to withstand Kha'Zix’s main damage. If the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike keeps you from securing kills, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Khazix.combo: Leap from a bush, throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair, then press Rengar Q Savagery right after your basic attack on landing to weave it between attacks. If Kha'Zix has already used E Leap, look for a root with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. After taking heavy damage from Kha'Zix's counterattack, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar and continue basic attacking.
Khazix.escape: The window for Rengar to engage opens right after Kha'Zix E Leap goes down. If you land Rengar E Bola Strike then, Kha'Zix will have a hard time escaping. If Kha'Zix disappears with R Void Assault, stay near your allies and counterattack the moment he reappears.
Khazix.fight: Avoid fights where you’re isolated and can be hit by Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Immediately after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage, stop his escape with Rengar E Bola Strike and fight him. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal right after taking heavy damage from his counterattack.
Khazix.laning: Closing in with a bush Leap can grant one Ferocity stack and reduce situations where throwing Rengar E Bola Strike before closing in gives Kha'Zix time to react. Don’t let Kha'Zix predict where you’re clearing jungle camps alone, and secure vision in river and jungle entrance bushes.
Khazix.phase: Rengar is strong in the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to build a lead. Once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions in the mid game, stop acting alone. Rengar’s engages become harder in the late game, so finish the game with your mid-game lead.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to prevent the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then engage from the side or behind after the enemy’s immobilizing abilities have been used on your front line. If Kha'Zix E Leap is down, root him with Rengar E Bola Strike and look for the kill. After taking retaliation, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar as you retreat.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear is much more dangerous against isolated targets, so stay near an ally or minion. Secure vision in bushes to reduce the chances of Kha'Zix slowing you with Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from out of vision. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay with your allies instead of scattering to find him, and look for the moment he reappears.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite repeatedly delays kills, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Kindred.combo: Leap from a bush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. After landing, use Rengar Q Savagery right after your basic attack to empower the next one, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking the opponent’s retaliation.
Kindred.escape: Don’t engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down. A good opportunity is before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up; disrupt her movement with Rengar E Bola Strike then. Plan an escape route before engaging, and if Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied while health drops, create distance or break vision.
Kindred.fight: After Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy goes down, close in with a bush Leap and slow with Rengar E Bola Strike during the Leap. If Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is also down, or she has little room to escape, focus your damage with empowered Rengar Q Savagery. If Kindred can escape with a mobility ability, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to root her.
Kindred.laning: Keep clearing jungle camps after healing damage with Rengar W Battle Roar. Clear camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision around them, to slow Kindred’s growth. Prioritize gank angles that let you Leap from a bush.
Kindred.phase: Contest camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred to slow Kindred’s growth. Actively target the back line in the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready. Engages become harder in the late game, so use your mid-game lead to finish the match.
Kindred.teamfight: Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then circle to the side or behind to target Kindred. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing abilities have been used on your front line, and, if needed, escape by cleansing crowd control with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. If Kindred R Lamb's Respite is activated, survive inside its zone and prepare for the fight after it ends.
Kindred.watch: If you keep taking hits after Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, you’ll take heavy damage, and the danger increases as your health drops. If you’re marked, create distance or break vision, and use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore health right after taking heavy damage. Don’t chase recklessly inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, where Kindred can keep moving with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If a long fight makes the vamp from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will a problem, consider Grievous Wounds.
LeeSin.combo: Leap from a bush, throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after your attack on landing to empower the next one. If Lee Sin can escape with a mobility ability, spend Ferocity to root him with Rengar E Bola Strike; if you’re already close enough that he can’t escape, increase your damage with empowered Rengar Q Savagery. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking a heavy counterattack.
LeeSin.escape: The chance to engage comes before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up. Lee Sin can still escape if Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is available, so confirm that both mobility options have been used. If Lee Sin still has an immobilizing counterattack, save Ferocity for Rengar W Battle Roar so you can cleanse it.
LeeSin.fight: If you meet Lee Sin in the early-game jungle, don’t accept the duel; back away. After Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down, check whether he has also used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will before engaging. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking retaliation while you’re in close range.
LeeSin.laning: Prioritize lanes where you can start a gank with Rengar’s Leap through a bush. If the angle makes it hard to use a bush, you’ll need to throw Rengar E Bola Strike before approaching, so lower that lane’s priority. If you expect a Lee Sin gank, put a minion or jungle monster between you to avoid the straight-line angle of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so don’t face him head-on in the jungle. In the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, pick off the back line to build a lead. Lee Sin’s power falls off in the late game, but enemy vision and defensive items also make it harder for Rengar to engage, so finish the game with your mid-game lead.
LeeSin.teamfight: Don’t start head-on. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or behind. Engage after the enemy’s immobilizing abilities have been used on your front line, and position yourself where it is difficult for Lee Sin to get behind you and cast Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. After the kill, use the healing or empowered effect from Rengar W Battle Roar to retreat along your planned route.
LeeSin.watch: Be wary of Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage when he has room to get behind you.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia’s main damage. Resistances don’t help against the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with your maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone. If healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough keeps you from securing kills, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Lillia.combo: Leap from a bush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair to slow Lillia when you land. After closing in, use Rengar Q Savagery right after your basic attack. Immediately after taking Lillia’s retaliation, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar, then continue basic attacking. If you need to stop Lillia’s escape, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike; if you are firmly in melee range, increase your damage with empowered Rengar Q Savagery.
Lillia.escape: The window to close in and engage opens right after you make Lillia use W Watch Out! Eep!. Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed too, so you engage without giving her movement speed stacks or meeting the condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. If you need to prepare for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Lillia.fight: Engage when Lillia misses her skills and has no movement speed stacks. Right after Lillia uses W Watch Out! Eep!, use Rengar E Bola Strike—or empowered root if needed—to stop her escape. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking retaliation, and spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar Q Savagery when you can stay on her.
Lillia.laning: While clearing jungle camps, heal the damage you take from monsters with Rengar W Battle Roar and continue clearing. Prioritize gank angles that let you Leap from a bush, and lower the priority of lanes where you can’t use a bush. When Lillia’s location is unknown, don’t pass straight through narrow jungle entrances or river passages where Lillia E Swirlseed could roll toward you.
Lillia.phase: Early ganks for Rengar depend heavily on bush terrain before your ultimate, so look for lanes with an angle for a bush Leap. In the mid game, use the strength of Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item to target Lillia after she misses a skill or uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make engaging harder, so look for a chance to end the game with your mid-game lead.
Lillia.teamfight: Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then circle in from the side or behind. If Lillia approaches from the side, save Rengar’s empowered E Bola Strike root for her, then catch her and kill her quickly by exploiting her low armor. Plan an escape route before engaging, and if you take retaliation, use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal and, when empowered, cleanse crowd control.
Lillia.watch: If you’re hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, you give her movement speed stacks and meet the condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby to put you to sleep. Don’t meet a Lillia whose location is unknown in a narrow passage. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin, move to the side to avoid its center. If you’re caught by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe place during the drowsy period before you fall asleep.

MasterYi.build: Withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style with your total health. If healing from Master Yi W Meditate keeps you from securing kills, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
MasterYi.combo: Leap from a bush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after your attack to weave it between basic attacks, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking Master Yi’s retaliation. Hold your finishing blow while Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is active, and interrupt Master Yi W Meditate with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike’s root when he uses it.
MasterYi.escape: Make Master Yi use Q Alpha Strike, then close in and land Rengar E Bola Strike when he reappears. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t rely on the slow from regular Rengar E Bola Strike; use the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
MasterYi.fight: You can fight Master Yi in the early-game jungle at close range. Catch him with Rengar E Bola Strike just after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, and use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal right after taking heavy damage from his counterattack. If there is no escape route and you can stay close, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar Q Savagery.
MasterYi.laning: In the jungle, manage your health with Rengar W Battle Roar as you clear camps and gank. When ganking, prioritize angles where you can approach via a bush and leap, and take objectives quickly during Master Yi’s weak early jungle phase to slow his growth.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the early-game jungle, so build a lead through fights and objectives. Rengar is strong in the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to secure your lead. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on while Rengar’s engages get harder, so end the game with your mid-game lead.
MasterYi.teamfight: If Master Yi uses W Meditate, interrupt him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then engage from the side or behind, with an escape route planned in advance.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while casting Q Alpha Strike, so land Rengar E Bola Strike just after he reappears. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don’t work, and attacks with Master Yi E Wuju Style active include true damage, so don’t stay in close range and take hits for long.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on a large health increase alone. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin keeps you from securing kills, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
MonkeyKing.combo: Leap from a bush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. If Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, root the real Wukong with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike, then use Rengar Q Savagery between basic attacks once you’re close. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Wukong’s retaliation.
MonkeyKing.escape: The chance to engage comes before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up, but check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available too. You can force a fight right after Wukong R Cyclone goes down. Before engaging, decide whether to save Rengar W Battle Roar for healing after retaliation or empower it to cleanse crowd control.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin stacks armor and healing the longer the fight goes on, so deal damage briefly and back off. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster goes down, identify the real Wukong and account for his remaining mobility option, Wukong E Nimbus Strike, before engaging. After closing in, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar if you take heavy damage.
MonkeyKing.laning: For early ganks, prioritize angles where stepping into a bush lets you start with a Leap from Rengar P Unseen Predator. If Wukong W Warrior Trickster is ready, don’t pour damage into the clone; target the real Wukong after it goes down. Manage your health while clearing jungle camps with Rengar W Battle Roar.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, pick off the back line to build a lead. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make engaging harder, so use your mid-game lead to end the game.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: After Wukong uses crowd control on your front line, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and engage from the side or behind. After a kill, use the healing or empowered effect from Rengar W Battle Roar to escape along a route you planned in advance.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted and can’t be dodged, so wait outside its range. Getting hit by Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, and Wukong R Cyclone knocks up multiple enemies, so spread out from allies while his ultimate is ready. Don’t waste abilities on the stationary clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster; watch the direction the real Wukong escapes.

Nidalee.build: If healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge / Swipe makes kills difficult, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance against the damage from Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown and W Bushwhack / Pounce.
Nidalee.combo: Leap from a bush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. If you can stay on the target, use Rengar Q Savagery right after your basic attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking retaliation damage.
Nidalee.escape: The chance to engage comes right after Nidalee uses Pounce from W Bushwhack / Pounce. If you land the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike then, Nidalee will have a hard time escaping. Nidalee has no crowd control, so make sure you’ve dodged her spear and traps before engaging.
Nidalee.fight: After dodging her spear and traps, bait out Pounce from Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, then close the gap. Catch her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike’s root, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar when you’ve taken heavy damage.
Nidalee.laning: Assume Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps are in jungle entrances and river, and check for them as you enter with Control Ward or an area ability such as Rengar W Battle Roar. Prioritize gank angles that let you approach through a bush and use a Leap from Rengar P Unseen Predator.
Nidalee.phase: Rengar’s early ganks are inconsistent because they depend on bush terrain, so target lanes with an angle for a bush Leap. In the mid game, when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, use Nidalee’s location to find chances to pick her off. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make engaging harder, so use your mid-game lead to finish the match.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee came out to throw her spear. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or behind. If Nidalee’s Pounce from W Bushwhack / Pounce is down, catch her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike’s root. Plan an escape route before engaging, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking retaliation.
Nidalee.watch: The farther away Nidalee’s spear from Q Javelin Toss / Takedown comes from, the more damage it deals, so make sure to dodge it especially when she’s far away, and put minions or your front line between you and her. Dodge Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps too, so she can’t mark you. If you’re marked, save Rengar E Bola Strike for the moment Nidalee dives in with Pounce.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first against Nocturne’s main damage. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is preventing kills, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Nocturne.combo: Leap from brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use regular Rengar E Bola Strike first to break the spell shield, then use saved Ferocity for empowered Rengar E Bola Strike when you need to prevent his escape. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after an attack to follow up with your next one, and use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking retaliation.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, Nocturne has no mobility tool other than his ultimate, so root him with Rengar E Bola Strike and engage then. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, save a way to create distance or prepare Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse the fear if it lands.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use regular Rengar E Bola Strike first to break the spell shield, then root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike when you have enough Ferocity. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal right after taking heavy damage from Nocturne’s retaliation.
Nocturne.laning: While jungling, use Rengar W Battle Roar to manage your health and keep clearing camps and ganking. When ganking, prioritize angles that let you leap from brush, and if you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t retreat in a straight line. Keep vision at the river and jungle entrances so you can find a place to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated.
Nocturne.phase: Rengar is strong in mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, so build an advantage with backline picks then. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to close out the game.
Nocturne.teamfight: If Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don’t get isolated; immediately move toward your allies. When attacking, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and engage from the side or behind after the opponent uses an immobilizing ability on your frontline. Choose an escape route before going in, then escape with the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar or its empowered crowd control cleanse.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, and successfully blocking one greatly increases Nocturne’s attack speed, so don’t immediately throw empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror must stay connected to fear you, so save a way to create distance the moment the fear takes effect. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, turn toward an ally or turret so he can’t chase you along the trail.

Nunu.build: If Nunu & Willump Q Consume's healing makes it hard to finish them off, fit Executioner's Calling in between core items. Build magic resistance first to mitigate their damage, and get tenacity to deal with the snowball and root.
Nunu.combo: Leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing to slow them. After the leap attack, use Rengar Q Savagery to empower your next basic attack, and use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from Nunu & Willump's retaliation. If you need to root Nunu & Willump for sure, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike; if you need to remove a root, spend it on empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Nunu.escape: It's an opportunity to engage after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! misses or passes by. If the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage is still available, go in with Ferocity ready for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. If Nunu & Willump is channeling R Absolute Zero, engage when you can interrupt it with the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Nunu.fight: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! passes and you dodge the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, close in with a brush leap. Nunu & Willump has no skill to create distance, so use Rengar E Bola Strike to root them and create a chance to kill. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to restore health.
Nunu.laning: Even after one gank, Nunu & Willump can come back by way of the river scuttle, so don't let your guard down right away. Rengar should prioritize ganks where a brush path lets him leap in.
Nunu.phase: Rengar is strongest in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so use the advantage gained in mid game to close out the match.
Nunu.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Engage the back line after Nunu & Willump uses their immobilizing abilities on your frontline, and decide your exit route in advance. When Nunu & Willump starts R Absolute Zero, interrupt it with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike or get out of range.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from a distance and knocks you up, so watch for the snowball rolling in from out of vision. Instead of running with your back to it, walk in the direction it is traveling and move into the space Nunu & Willump just passed through. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move immediately to avoid the root that follows.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. There's little need to build magic resistance just for Poppy, and avoid relying on a large health increase alone because Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike in midair. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after landing and attacking, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after Poppy retaliates. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available, decide before engaging whether to root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike or save empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to break the stun.
Poppy.escape: The window to engage is after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and just after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge. Catch her with Rengar E Bola Strike, and if Poppy's immobilizing effect is still on you, remove it with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Poppy.fight: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, leap in from a brush. If Poppy's retaliation deals heavy damage, use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately to heal, and don't stay in the area of Poppy Q Hammer Shock. Poppy's armor can increase even at low health, so engage only when you can finish her off for sure.
Poppy.laning: Prioritize gank angles where stepping into a brush lets you leap. When facing Poppy, don't put your back to a wall or narrow passage. If Poppy P Iron Ambassador's shield lands on the ground, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.phase: Rengar's early ganks depend on brush terrain, so choose routes that give you a leap angle. Rengar is strongest in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game advantage to close out the match.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then circle around from the side or rear. Engage the back line after Poppy W Steadfast Presence and her immobilizing abilities have been used. If you take retaliation, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar or empower it to remove crowd control, then escape along your planned route.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks Rengar P Unseen Predator's leap, so wait it out or approach on foot. Stand in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you if your back is to a wall. If the first hit of Poppy Q Hammer Shock connects, leave the area before the second damage instance goes off. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, dodge sideways from in front of her.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. Prioritize tenacity too if you often die while locked down by crowd control. If you have to fight Rammus directly, choose percent penetration to account for the increased resistances from Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Rammus.combo: Leap from a brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike to slow him. After landing, use Rengar Q Savagery between basic attacks, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking damage from his retaliation. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is still available, spend empowered ability use on Rengar W Battle Roar, and stop basic attacking when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.
Rammus.escape: It's a good time to engage once Rammus E Frenzying Taunt has also been used up.
Rammus.fight: While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don't use the fast basic attack from Rengar Q Savagery on him; back off or target someone else. Once Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and you can watch for Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, unload your damage. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal right after taking damage from his retaliation.
Rammus.laning: Early on, approach along a brush path and engage with a leap from Rengar P Unseen Predator. Put minions between you and the path of an incoming Rammus Q Powerball, and stop trading when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. Lower the priority of engages that can't use a brush, since they give Rammus time to react.
Rammus.phase: Early gank success for Rengar depends heavily on brush terrain, so choose angles where you can use a brush. In mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, pick off the back line to build an advantage. In late game, vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game advantage to close out the match.
Rammus.teamfight: Instead of attacking Rammus from the front, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate a back-line target and approach from the side or rear. Engage after Rammus E Frenzying Taunt or another immobilizing ability is used on your frontline, and avoid the wide landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam that follows Rammus Q Powerball. After the kill, heal from retaliation damage with Rengar W Battle Roar and escape along your planned route.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him. Dodge the fast Rammus R Soaring Slam widely, then move away from its landing point as well. Rammus has high armor and reflects basic attack damage while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, so stop attacking. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and skill use, so don't enter its range first.

RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai gets in the way of a kill, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Armor can't reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
RekSai.combo: Leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack to empower the next one. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after Rek'Sai retaliates and deals damage. If maximum Ferocity is ready and Rek'Sai still has an escape, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
RekSai.escape: Look for an opening after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up and Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel's movement are down. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so catch her with Rengar E Bola Strike before her ultimate comes back up.
RekSai.fight: Close in with a brush leap and slow Rek'Sai with Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore health right after taking damage from Rek'Sai's retaliation. If Rek'Sai can escape, spend maximum Ferocity on the root from Rengar E Bola Strike.
RekSai.laning: Early on, don't cross areas without vision alone, so you don't give Rek'Sai a kill during her ganks. Walk over visible entrances to Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to destroy them. Rengar should prioritize gank angles that let him leap from a brush.
RekSai.phase: Early on, watch for Rek'Sai's ganks and keep her from getting kills while buying time. Rengar is strong in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line then to build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so use the mid-game advantage to close out the match.
RekSai.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Leap onto a back-line target after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up has been used, and decide your escape route before engaging. After taking retaliation damage, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar as you disengage.
RekSai.watch: Watch out for the knock-up when Rek'Sai erupts from the ground with W Burrow / Un-burrow. When Rek'Sai goes underground, avoid walls and narrow paths and move toward open space. Stay close to allies immediately after Rek'Sai hits you, since Rek'Sai R Void Rush can follow up.

Sejuani.build: Rengar is strong in mid game when his first core item is ready, so focus on reaching that point sooner. Build magic resistance first against Sejuani's main damage, and watch separately for the physical damage from Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. If Sejuani's crowd control keeps locking you down, you can prioritize tenacity.
Sejuani.combo: Leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike in midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack. If Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If she can retaliate with an immobilizing effect once you're close, save empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking damage from her retaliation.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is her only mobility tool, so the moment after she uses it is an opening to engage. Going in after Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison is down reduces the risk of being locked down. Decide your escape route before engaging, and remove immobilizing effects with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar if you get caught.
Sejuani.fight: Close the gap right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down and catch her with Rengar E Bola Strike. Don't rely on slows to chase while Sejuani P Fury of the North has her Frost Armor active, since slows don't work on it. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore health right after taking heavy damage from her retaliation.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, manage jungle health with Rengar W Battle Roar as you clear camps and gank. Prioritize lanes where you can use a brush to leap in, and lower the priority of ganks without a brush. Secure early jungle control and objectives before Sejuani scales.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Sejuani's kill and damage stats are low, so Rengar should look to take jungle control and objectives. Rengar is strong in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to build an advantage. In late game, Sejuani's defenses grow and Rengar has a harder time engaging, so use your mid-game advantage to close out the match.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or rear. Engage a back-line target after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, or Sejuani R Glacial Prison has been used on your frontline. Deal burst damage, then use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal or remove crowd control with its empowered effect as you escape along your planned route.
Sejuani.watch: When you see the tell for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison, move sideways to dodge. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath's first hit connects, get out of range before the second hit. Sejuani E Permafrost also gains stacks from basic attacks by melee allies, so back away when the indicator fills.

Shaco.build: Get Control Wards and Oracle Lens early to clear Shaco W Jack In The Box. Build magic resistance first against Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Secure health as well so you can avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage.
Shaco.combo: In fights where you need to chase, throw Rengar E Bola Strike during a brush leap, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack. If Shaco Q Deceive is down and Ferocity is maxed, root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If you have to take the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, save your empowered ability for Rengar W Battle Roar to remove the crowd control.
Shaco.escape: Focus Shaco with your allies right after he enters a fight with Q Deceive and appears. Once Shaco Q Deceive is down, block his escape route with Rengar E Bola Strike. Before engaging, check the location of Shaco W Jack In The Box and your escape route. If the fear is still available, prepare empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Shaco.fight: Close in right after baiting out Shaco Q Deceive, then chase with Rengar E Bola Strike. Leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike in midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack to keep attacking. If Shaco's retaliation deals heavy damage, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar.
Shaco.laning: Early on, keep vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's invades and ganks. Manage your health while clearing with Rengar W Battle Roar, and continue clearing camps and ganking. Prioritize gank angles that let you leap from a brush, and check for Shaco W Jack In The Box before entering a brush without vision.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco's ganks and invades, avoid giving him kills, and secure objectives. Rengar is strong in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line then to build an advantage. Shaco's solo fighting power drops in late game, but Rengar also has a harder time engaging, so use the advantage gained in mid game to close out the match.
Shaco.teamfight: Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and approach from the side or rear. When Shaco enters with Q Deceive, focus your damage on the real one with your allies, and watch health bar reactions so you don't waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate's clone. Before engaging, check when crowd control will be used and your escape route; if needed, remove fear with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush without vision and around objectives. If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his first attack is stronger, so if he's nearby, keep your back to a wall or face toward your allies. A Jack In The Box remains where Shaco R Hallucinate's clone dies, so back away immediately.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon's Descent, and consider armor against her basic attacks as well. If healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis turns a kill around, fit Executioner's Calling in between core items.
Shyvana.combo: Leap from a brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike in midair to slow her, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after the basic attack on landing to empower the next one. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Shyvana's retaliation, then continue basic attacking. If you need to catch her after Shyvana R Dragon's Descent lands, use empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to root her.
Shyvana.escape: A good window to catch Shyvana is after her mobility tool, R Dragon's Descent, is down.
