Save your root while Shyvana is coming in with R Dragon's Descent, then hit her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike after she lands. Look for an engage too when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty or her transformation ends and she returns to human form.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and look for an opening if Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down. Leap in from a brush, take damage from her retaliation, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar. If Shyvana might escape, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike; if you can stay on her for sure, increase your damage with empowered Rengar Q Savagery.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, approach along a brush path and look for ganks with a leap. If Shyvana's Fury bar is full, don't start an objective in front of her.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana is at her weakest early on, before she has stacks, so pressure her camps and objectives to slow her growth. Rengar is strongest in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line then to build an advantage. Shyvana gets stronger as she gains stacks, and Rengar has a harder time engaging late, so use your mid-game advantage to close out the match.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out your formation so Shyvana's dragon-form area attacks don't hit several players at once. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate a back-line target, then circle around from the side or rear and leap along a path that makes that target the nearest enemy. Decide your escape route before engaging, then heal the damage you take with Rengar W Battle Roar after your burst.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable during its dash, so don't try to stop it with Rengar E Bola Strike while she's flying in. After she lands, watch out for the slow and maximum-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and the empowered basic attack and true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike. Shyvana can endure damage and heal with Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, so if her retaliation hits hard, use Rengar W Battle Roar immediately afterward.

Skarner.build: Decide early whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build for Skarner R Impale. If you build resistances, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone.
Skarner.combo: Engage with a brush leap and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing. Then use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking Skarner's retaliation before continuing your basic attacks. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to block his escape; if you can stay on him for sure, increase your damage with empowered Q Savagery.
Skarner.escape: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is Rengar's window to engage. If Skarner R Impale is down too, you can engage without worrying about suppression. If both abilities are available, delay your engage, and when you go in, choose a position away from walls and an escape route.
Skarner.fight: Close the gap right after Skarner uses E Ixtal's Impact, then slow him with Rengar E Bola Strike or root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If you're in range, use Rengar Q Savagery right after a basic attack, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage. If immobilizing effects from Skarner's retaliation remain, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar W Battle Roar, but don't expect it to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.laning: Early on, keep clearing the jungle while managing your health with Rengar W Battle Roar. Prioritize gank angles that let you leap from a brush, and choose routes that won't get you pinned against a wall when facing Skarner. Secure early jungle control and objectives to delay Skarner's tank items.
Skarner.phase: Early gank success for Rengar depends heavily on brush terrain, so take control from favorable angles and delay Skarner's item timing. Rengar is strong in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and his first core item are ready, so pick off the back line to build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, while Skarner gets tanky and can still deal damage if given time, so use your mid-game advantage to close out the match.
Skarner.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then circle around from the side or rear. Engage the back line after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale have been used on your frontline, and make sure the target of Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt's leap is the enemy you want. After your burst, heal with Rengar W Battle Roar and escape along your planned route.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain, and being grabbed then hitting a wall stuns you, so don't stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale suppresses and drags you, and empowered Rengar W Battle Roar can't remove it, so delay your engage while Skarner is nearby. Spend less time in range so you don't keep getting hit by the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth keep catching you, get tenacity too. Rengar’s main physical damage is effective against Taliyah’s low armor.
Taliyah.combo: Leap from brush, throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after landing and making a basic attack. Heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking the opponent’s retaliation, then continue basic attacking. Before engaging, decide whether to spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to prevent escape, empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse crowd control, or empowered Rengar Q Savagery to deal more damage.
Taliyah.escape: Don’t go in just because Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down; look for a window before Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall comes back up. Enter at an angle that avoids the minefield, then catch her with Rengar E Bola Strike. If you’re still at risk of being caught by Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Taliyah.fight: Check for the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth; if it’s there, take a leap route around it or approach on foot. Once you’re on top of her, use Rengar Q Savagery right after an attack, and heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage. If Taliyah is trying to escape, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
Taliyah.laning: Early ganks should prioritize angles that let you leap from brush. Opening with a leap from brush can give you one Ferocity stack, and you can also slow with Rengar E Bola Strike mid-leap. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may be setting up a play in another lane, so back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Early Rengar has trouble ganking from angles without brush, so use brush and watch for Taliyah to make plays in other lanes. Rengar is strong in mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, so find a side route to reach Taliyah and build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so use your mid-game lead to close out the match.
Taliyah.teamfight: Don’t start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate Taliyah, then approach from the side or behind. Engage after Taliyah uses her immobilizing ability on your frontline, and check whether Taliyah E Unraveled Earth’s minefield is in your leap path. After dealing damage, use the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar or its empowered crowd control cleanse to escape along a route you chose in advance.
Taliyah.watch: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth lays down a minefield, don’t leap across it with Rengar P Unseen Predator. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while being cast, so sidestep it.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. However, Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is stopping you from securing kills, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Udyr.combo: Leap from brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair to slow Udyr when you land. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after an attack, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar after taking Udyr’s retaliation. If Udyr tries to escape with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, wait for his Awakened effect to end, then root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If you need to take the stun, spend Ferocity on empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Udyr.escape: The moment you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap and fight. A target stunned once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede can’t be stunned again for a while, so retaliate or escape during that window. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so apply the empowered root from Rengar E Bola Strike after it ends.
Udyr.fight: Focus your damage after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle has been removed, and don’t give him time to heal. If you’re stunned by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, save Ferocity so you can empower Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse it. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to heal back what you took.
Udyr.laning: Track Udyr’s pathing with vision at jungle entrances and key routes, and don’t overextend in lane when he’s missing. Rengar can sustain with Rengar W Battle Roar while clearing camps. When ganking, prioritize angles that let you leap from brush.
Udyr.phase: Early Rengar ganks depend heavily on brush terrain, so avoid forcing your way in. In mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, pick off the backline to build an advantage. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to close out the game.
Udyr.teamfight: Target a vulnerable enemy behind Udyr rather than attacking him first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then enter from the side or behind after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun has been used on an ally. After dealing damage, use the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar or its empowered crowd control cleanse to escape along a route you chose in advance.
Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch out for the stun on his first attack. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and the latter also slows. Don’t rush a kill while the shield and healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle are still active.

Vi.build: Build armor first because Vi’s main damage is physical. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choosing items that only add a lot of health. Since Vi’s basic attacks and attack speed contribute to her damage, consider ways to reduce her attack speed too.
Vi.combo: Leap from brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before landing to slow Vi. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after landing and attacking, then heal with Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from Vi’s retaliation. If Ferocity is full, use empowered Rengar E Bola Strike if Vi might escape with Vi Q Vault Breaker, or empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse the remaining crowd control.
Vi.escape: The window to go in is right after Vi Q Vault Breaker misses or is used. Catch Vi with Rengar E Bola Strike and deal a short burst. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, wait for her to use it before engaging.
Vi.fight: Close the gap right after dodging or baiting Vi Q Vault Breaker. Slow her with Rengar E Bola Strike, and if she seems to need an escape tool, root her with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, wait for it to be removed, deal a short burst, then create distance.
Vi.laning: In the jungle, use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal the damage you take from monsters and keep clearing camps. When ganking, prioritize angles that let you leap with Rengar P Unseen Predator from brush. Vi may activate Vi P Blast Shield right after using an ability on a minion, so fight after the shield has been removed.
Vi.phase: Early Rengar ganks depend heavily on brush terrain, so target places where you can use brush first. Rengar is strongest in mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, so pick off the backline while Vi’s engage ability is down. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder for Rengar to engage, so use your mid-game lead to close out the match.
Vi.teamfight: Don’t start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or behind. Engage on the backline after the immobilizing abilities, including Vi R Cease and Desist, have been spent on your frontline. After your burst, heal the retaliation damage with Rengar W Battle Roar, then cleanse any remaining crowd control with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar and escape along a route you chose in advance.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it’s charged, so back off or move sideways when you see her charging. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and increases her attack speed when she repeatedly hits the same target, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight. Vi R Cease and Desist won’t stop during its dash, so if it hits you, respond after the knock-up ends.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If duels drag on because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, get resistances first, then fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Viego.combo: Leap from brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike before you land. Once you’re on top of the target, use Rengar Q Savagery right after an attack, and use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from retaliation.
Viego.escape: Don’t go in just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down; check whether Viego R Heartbreaker is still available. The window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back is especially good for engaging; root him then with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. If you’re still at risk of being hit by Viego W Spectral Maw, save Ferocity for empowered Rengar W Battle Roar.
Viego.fight: Step into brush to leap with Rengar P Unseen Predator, and decide before engaging which empowered ability to use. If the stun from Viego W Spectral Maw is still available, cleanse it with empowered Rengar W Battle Roar. If Viego’s escape is down, root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to heal back what you took.
Viego.laning: While jungling, use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal the damage you take and keep clearing camps. When ganking, prioritize angles with brush so you can open with Rengar P Unseen Predator, and lower the priority of lanes where you can’t use brush. If you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path, avoid that route. In small fights you can’t win, back off without giving up a kill.
Viego.phase: Rengar is strongest in mid game once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, so pick off the backline without giving Viego a kill. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to finish the game.
Viego.teamfight: Don’t start from the front. Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target, then approach from the side or behind. Go in after the opponent uses an immobilizing ability on your frontline, kill the backline, then escape with the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar or its empowered effect. Don’t keep fighting where an ally has fallen; root Viego with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to stop him from possessing them.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it’s charged, so sidestep when you see him charging and interrupt him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike’s root. If Viego E Harrowed Path covers terrain, watch out for him in the mist and go around the passage. When your health is low, back off because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Also get armor to account for the physical damage from his basic attacks, and buy Executioner’s Calling between core items if his healing makes it hard to finish him. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar if you need to immediately cleanse the suppression from Warwick R Infinite Duress.
Warwick.combo: Engage with a leap from brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair, then use Rengar Q Savagery right after landing and attacking to weave it between basic attacks. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal right after taking Warwick’s retaliation. If the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl is still available, choose empowered W; if you need to prevent his escape, choose empowered E.
Warwick.escape: Don’t go in just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; check whether Warwick R Infinite Duress is still available too. In particular, engage during the window before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes off cooldown, after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has also been used, and use Rengar E Bola Strike to prevent his escape.
Warwick.fight: Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then go back in after the fear triggers. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage to heal, and save Ferocity for empowered W if you need to prepare for the fear. Warwick’s healing gets stronger at low health, so don’t dive based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: Early on, take advantage of Warwick’s slow jungle clear to gain an edge through jungle invades and lane priority. Rengar should approach along a route that passes through brush and prioritize ganking lanes where he can leap. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so don’t overstay; recall instead.
Warwick.phase: In mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, focus on picking off the backline. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to finish the game.
Warwick.teamfight: Use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and circle around to the side or behind. Engage after Warwick uses an immobilizing ability on your frontline. If an ally is caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, focus your retaliation on Warwick while he’s suppressing them to save your ally. Before engaging, plan an escape route using Rengar W Battle Roar.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and fear follows, so don’t use your burst; back off. Warwick R Infinite Duress makes him lunge from far away and suppress his target, so leave extra distance when Warwick’s movement speed is increased.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first to block Xin Zhao’s main damage. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination turns a kill around at the last moment, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Reducing his attack speed can also help reduce the damage from his basic attacks.
XinZhao.combo: Leap from brush with Rengar P Unseen Predator and throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair. Use Rengar Q Savagery right after landing and attacking to weave it between basic attacks. After taking Xin Zhao’s retaliation, use Rengar W Battle Roar; if he tries to escape, root him with empowered Rengar E Bola Strike.
XinZhao.escape: Go in right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used, and use Rengar E Bola Strike to prevent his escape. When Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third attack is coming, use Rengar P Unseen Predator’s mobility to get out of range.
XinZhao.fight: Right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to catch him with Rengar E Bola Strike. Use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore your health right after taking heavy damage from Xin Zhao’s retaliation. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, wait out its immunity and attack again after it ends.
XinZhao.laning: Approach along a route through brush to set up a leap. Lower the priority of gank angles where you can’t use brush. In the jungle, use Rengar W Battle Roar to manage your health and keep clearing camps and ganking.
XinZhao.phase: Early Rengar ganks depend heavily on brush terrain, so choose your entry angle carefully. Build an advantage with backline picks in mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready. In late game, it gets harder for Rengar to engage, so use your mid-game lead to close out the game.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard can split your formation with its knockback, so don’t stand too close to your allies. After Xin Zhao’s immobilizing ability is used, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate your target and engage from the side or behind. After a kill, use the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar and the crowd control cleanse from an empowered ability to escape.
XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. Be especially careful because getting hit by the thrust increases the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike hits you twice with its empowered attacks, get out of range before the third attack knocks you up.

Zac.build: Build your first core item, but if healing from Zac P Cell Division is preventing kills, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Zac’s damage. Consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas instead of adding a lot of health alone.
Zac.combo: Leap from brush and throw Rengar E Bola Strike midair, then follow up with Rengar Q Savagery after landing and attacking. Use Rengar W Battle Roar right after taking heavy damage from Zac’s retaliation. Choose empowered Rengar E Bola Strike to stop Zac E Elastic Slingshot or prevent his escape, and empowered Rengar W Battle Roar to cleanse an immobilizing effect.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot has been used is Rengar’s chance to go in. Before engaging, also plan an escape route using brush or movement speed.
Zac.fight: If you see Zac charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot and can use empowered Rengar E Bola Strike, root him to interrupt the charge. Close the gap right after Zac uses E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Rengar E Bola Strike. During the fight, step on Zac’s blobs to prevent him from healing, and use Rengar W Battle Roar to restore your health right after taking heavy damage.
Zac.laning: While jungling, use Rengar W Battle Roar to heal the damage you take and keep clearing camps. When ganking, prioritize angles that let you leap from brush, and look for the opening right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used. Lower the priority of ganks from angles where you can’t use brush.
Zac.phase: Early Rengar ganks depend heavily on brush terrain, so avoid forcing an engage. In mid game, once Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and your first core item are ready, target the backline while Zac’s engage is down. In late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage, so use your mid-game lead to finish the game.
Zac.teamfight: After dealing with Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s engage, create distance to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. If Zac uses an immobilizing ability on your frontline, use Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to locate a backline target and circle around to the side or behind. After a kill, use the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar or its empowered crowd control cleanse to escape along a route you chose in advance.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so avoid the engage route if you see him charging behind a wall. Zac Q Stretching Strikes can knock you up and Zac R Let’s Bounce! can slow you afterward, so don’t dive in while his immobilizing effects are still available. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so spend less time close to him.
